localAxes.planarAxes: XZ plane: local x = i to j, local y = global +Y, local z = x cross y.
localAxes.spatialAxes: local x = i to j; y = normalize(reference cross x); z = x cross y; reference vectors are explicit per member.
localAxes.reactionNaming: Rz in the task means vertical support force Fz, not nodal rotation rz.
